title: Vortex Mojito 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Mojito recreates the classic cocktail with a zesty blend of Lime, crisp Mint, and a refreshing cooling exhale. This lively and invigorating flavour is a great choice for vapers seeking a tangy and uplifting vape experience. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, Mojito balances rich flavour with smooth vapour, making it ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices such as pod systems and starter kits. The nic salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and fast-acting nicotine relief, perfect for everyday vaping. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts come in a 10ml format, offering a longer-lasting and more sustainable alternative to disposable vape devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Mojito is an exciting choice for fans of citrus and mint flavour combinations.
